subject: zoology_2
question_text: List out any four features of cancer cells.

verification.note: Sourced from 'My Baby Bullet-Q — Senior Inter Zoology' (Star-Q Pass Track Series, Sri Publishers, 2022), book p.59, VSAQ 137. The printed exam years are the book's claim, reproduced here as appearances. Zoology-II holds only ONE source book in the corpus, so the two-book union check is structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is our reading of the question and is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. Revision (examiner audit, 2026-09-05): step 2's memory tip taught blood vessels while its second mistake condemned them, and neither matches the four features this card prints, so both now follow the printed features.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Growth and spread
steps.why: A cancer cell ignores the signals that would normally stop it dividing or hold it in place.
steps.memory_tip: Grow without stopping, then break away.
lines: 1. Cancer cells actively grow and divide
2. They can easily detach themselves and

steps.label: Lost controls
steps.why: The two safety systems that should stop them — contact inhibition and apoptosis — have both failed.
common_mistakes: Confusing apoptosis with necrosis. Apoptosis is programmed cell death.
steps.memory_tip: No contact inhibition, and no apoptosis.
lines: 3. They lose the property of contact

insider_note: Four features for two marks, so two per mark. Keep each to one short line.
